name: Frozen diagnostic audit, not a new factor admission or deployment
horizon_entry: signal+1 close; exit entry+h sessions or next weekly signal+1 close; no price filling
horizon_selection: Form scores, deciles, top decile and top15 before checking future return availability. Report coverage. Common sample affects statistical evaluation only, never target generation.
horizon_uncertainty: Pointwise HAC normal intervals with 12 weekly lags; descriptive only, overlapping labels and many tests preclude automatic admission/significance claims.
weight_comparison: Change lookback only; preserve minimum120, monthly updates, cap20%, max5pp change, fallback and all execution/risk rules. Use matured labels only.
family_ablation: Delete one of five families from the original252 nominal weights, renormalize remaining weights without re-estimating them. Preserve the common eligible universe, standardization and portfolio rules. No parameter selection.

random_top15.sampling: Uniform without replacement from contemporaneous common score-eligible candidates, independently each weekly signal. Not industry-matched, not an independent hypothesis-test p-value.

benchmarks: common pool equal-weight with same already-causal target-equity series and action dates as BASE_RISK for each fee
lag: At each monthly update evaluate known trailing mean IC and actual weight against next calendar month's daily factor IC, only reporting fully matured labels. Future IC is evaluation-only. Report weight changes, cap/smoothing gap, fallback, turnover and industry composition changes.
limitations: All historical data already observed: this is retrospective diagnosis, not new untouched OOS.
Inherited revised financial data, partial historical industries and cash-flow proxy.
Weekly factor diagnostics use the saved standardized score panel; the historical daily IC weighting cache used raw-valid masks, so their IC means need not match.
Missing future prices are not replaced by zero; report missing coverage and common/native samples; not a complete delisting-return reconstruction.
Factor deletion and selection-stage deltas include interactions and changing holdings; they are not unique causal attributions.
No lots, real taxes, minimum commissions or limit-order queues. Missing old-position prices cause stale marks and blocked sells; intended-basket risk limitation retained.
No live defaults or paper accounts changed.
